Species Species.reasoning: Contains insect taxon names (e.g., Monomorium salomonis).
Species Species.reasoning_relevance: Records the taxonomic identity of the ant species observed.

Number of individuals Unburnt.reasoning: Records the count of individuals observed in the unburnt condition.
Number of individuals Unburnt.reasoning_relevance: Records the quantitative abundance (count) of individuals in unburnt plots.

Number of individuals Burnt.reasoning: Records the count of individuals observed in the burnt condition.
Number of individuals Burnt.reasoning_relevance: Records the quantitative abundance (count) of individuals in burnt plots.

Fire condition Estimate.reasoning: Records the calculated estimate (e.g., regression coefficient) for the fire condition.
Fire condition Estimate.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical estimate (coefficient) from a GLMM model.

Fire condition Std. Error.reasoning: Records the standard error associated with the fire condition estimate.
Fire condition Std. Error.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical measure of the precision of the estimate.

Fire condition P.reasoning: Records the p-value for the fire condition analysis.
Fire condition P.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical index (p-value) used for hypothesis testing.
